body:
Founder-corrected twice in real time (first scoped as BURROW/DUNG.md, then moved to this standalone repo). Real, corrected scope: standalone Bazel-built repo, editor domain is a ground-up PARENA-native port of PARENA's own stdlib/editor/*.prn, compiled via the real burrow CLI -- DUNG is BURROW's own real, live, flagship dogfooding consumer. Real UX foundation adopted directly (not invented): EmilyOS/docs/legacy-archive/gui-v0.1-design-capture.md already specifies a 'tmux x i3 hybrid' layout + no-single-click double-click-speed interaction contract + posture-aware non-modal safety feedback. Real, honest blocker named directly: burrow build isn't implemented yet, gated on BURROW's own Phase 3-4. Real, explicit non-goal: PITVIPER itself untouched. Registered in monorepo CLAUDE.md + golden-docs-index. Commits 2f82493/cdfb283.

⚓ ☃
title: Initial NORTHSTAR scoping pass -- DUNG, the BURROW editor
